key_insight: Pretraining neural policies with symbolic "logical options" injects structured, aligned behavior that reduces over-exploitation of early rewards and improves downstream deep RL performance in sparse/continuous tasks.
problem_solved: Addresses misalignment and poor sample efficiency in deep RL where agents exploit early dense signals and struggle with sparse objectives or scaling purely symbolic planners to continuous domains.
method: Two-stage hybrid pipeline: (1) derive symbolic logical options (structured subgoals/subpolicies) and use them to pretrain neural modules, (2) fine-tune the pretrained policy end-to-end with standard deep RL in the target environment.
Embed symbolic structure into neural representations so pretrained options guide exploration and credit assignment, while allowing gradient-based adaptation for continuous control.
impact: Provides a practical way to combine symbolic planning and neural learning, improving alignment, exploration, and sample efficiency for practitioners building RL agents in sparse or continuous domains.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: left = symbolic option generation → middle = pretraining neural modules → right = RL fine-tuning in environment

paper_title: Boosting deep Reinforcement Learning using pretraining with Logical Options
paper_authors: Zihan Ye, Phil Chau, Raban Emunds, Jannis Blüml, Cedric Derstroff
